newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's CPI unchanged in May from April.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's CPI unchanged in May from April.

text.p: Tunisia's consumer price index (CPI) remained unchanged in May compared to its level in April, official statistics showed on Monday.
It was up 0.9 percent in the first five months of 1997 compared to its level in December 1996.
The year on year index in May 1997 is put at 3.5 percent compared to 4.4 percent in May 1996.
Inflation as measured by the CPI was 3.7 percent for the whole year 1996 from 6.3 percent in 1995. Official forecasts put it at below four per cent for the whole year 1997.
